C0819.title: Shanghai Company Deleted Database After Data Leak to Evade Penalties
C0819.summary: In 2023, Shanghai cyberspace enforcement reports disclosed that multiple companies were penalized after data was suspected of leaking overseas. One company deleted the relevant database during enforcement, and the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration imposed dual penalties on both the company and directly responsible personnel under the Data Security Law. The case shows that evidence handling and cooperation during remediation can also affect regulatory liability after a data leak.

references.title: Shanghai Cyberspace Enforcement in 2023 Achieved New Results for Public and Business Services
